snippet.title: This is Mix Universe - A Musical Sandbox Game (Official Trailer 2024)
snippet.description:
Mix Universe is a musical sandbox game like no other. It has been a passion project of mine since late 2018 and is now in a state where the game has now become easier than ever to learn and play! It is still in early access, but improving with every update and is stable.

Download the Free Demo or Purchase on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1654810/Mix_Universe/

This video shows an example mix made in the game where I walk through and activate rings to change which nodes are currently displayed.

Please leave a review if you end up giving the game a go!
